title: Transfer accumulated text and empty its builder
goal: Hand accumulated text to a new StringBuilder while reusing an emptied source for the next batch.

selectionNotes: Transfer empties the source and invalidates assumptions about borrowed chunk views. Serialize access; this is not thread-safe handoff.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This edition uses .NET 11 library APIs; the .NET 10 code is a comparison, not a catalogue route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared net11.0 sample with the .NET 11 SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: The canonical net11.0 project selects the .NET 11 default C# 15 language mode.

prerequisites: Use a net11.0 console project with LangVersion=15.0. Include the imports stated in the recipe.
constraints: This is an ownership handoff, not a thread-safety primitive. Serialize access and stop enumerating old GetChunks results before transfer or subsequent mutation; those borrowed views do not become immutable snapshots. Do not assume capacity, maximum capacity, chunk layout or allocation counts remain identical to the copying version. Convert to a string separately if the consumer needs immutable text.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 verification; GA reconciliation remains pending.
